description: This file defines security configuration for a Spring Boot application, focusing on JWT authentication, authorization rules, CORS settings, and security filter chains.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up security features including JWT authentication, role-based access, CORS, and session management.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Creates and returns a BCryptPasswordEncoder for password hashing.

methods.name: authenticationProvider
methods.description: Provides a DAO-based authentication provider configured with user details service and password encoder.

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Retrieves the AuthenticationManager bean from AuthenticationConfiguration.

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Configures HTTP security including authorizations, CORS, CSRF, session management, and filters.

methods.name: corsConfigurationSource
methods.description: Sets up a CORS configuration allowing all origins and various HTTP methods for development.
